description: Defines data classes related to chat messaging, including message content, session management, and attachments.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents an individual chat message with id, role, content, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Represents the content of a chat message, including text, mime type, and optional file information.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Represents an ongoing or pending tool call within a chat, including id, name, args, and status.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Stores information about a chat session, such as key, last update timestamp, and display name.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: Contains a collection of messages belonging to a particular chat session.

classes.name: OutgoingAttachment
classes.description: Represents a file attachment with type, mime type, filename, and base64-encoded data.
